<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d0cac7a4f8a349c8951c456b6be279f6~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=A5%2BJrF992aqdAUeVXjOn5yGmP0w%3D" alt="003360截图20250927231943953.png" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2 data-id="heading-0">使用技术</h2>
<ul>
<li>开发工具：vscode</li>
<li>跨平台框架：electron^38.1.2</li>
<li>前端框架技术：vite^7.1.7+vue^3.5.21+vue-router^4.5.1</li>
<li>UI组件库：element-plus^2.11.3</li>
<li>状态插件：pinia^3.0.3</li>
<li>国际化方案：vue-i18n^11.1.12</li>
<li>图表组件：echarts^6.0.0</li>
<li>markdown编辑器：md-editor-v3^6.0.1</li>
<li>模拟数据：mockjs^1.1.0</li>
<li>打包工具：electron-builder^24.13.3</li>
<li>electron+vite整合插件：vite-plugin-electron^0.29.0</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/19ee97768fbe4bc9b08fa95348d16b72~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=8af2ZlY1eu81%2BnOudBJ3st27xZE%3D" alt="p5.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e7c631036d384adeb4402f171a71c470~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=derAHGPDmORUfdADJon3VhJefy4%3D" alt="p3.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">项目功能特征</h2>
<ol>
<li>基于最新技术栈Electron38、Vite7、Vue3 setup、Pinia3、ElementPlus、Vue-I18n、Echarts</li>
<li>支持中英文/繁体三种国际化语言</li>
<li>支持动态权限路由、面包屑导航、快捷标签栏缓存路由</li>
<li>electron38封装高复用多窗口管理</li>
<li>内置4种通用布局模板、自由变换风格</li>
<li>整合常用的表格、表单、列表、图表、编辑器、错误处理等业务模块</li>
</ol>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/6cf30dc3092d400ca756c1072a33cdd1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=KYm%2B69AbtkkXinemXyiRYJ%2FycYU%3D" alt="p4.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">项目框架目录</h2>
<p>使用最新跨平台技术Electron38整合Vite7搭建项目模板。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/c8113d685d4742888bdf42da76573fc8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=OBVb0C1oYUPsyKPiIO%2BU8pcKTn4%3D" alt="360截图20250927220018261.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">electron多窗口进程配置</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * electron主进程配置
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@author</span> <span class="hljs-variable">andy</span>
 */</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { app, <span class="hljs-title class_">BrowserWindow</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'electron'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">WindowManager</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'../src/windows/index.js'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 忽略安全警告提示 Electron Security Warning (Insecure Content-Security-Policy)</span>
process.<span class="hljs-property">env</span>[<span class="hljs-string">'ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS'</span>] = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">createWindow</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> win = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WindowManager</span>()
  win.<span class="hljs-title function_">create</span>({<span class="hljs-attr">isMajor</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>})
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 系统托盘管理</span>
  win.<span class="hljs-title function_">trayManager</span>()
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 监听ipcMain事件</span>
  win.<span class="hljs-title function_">ipcManager</span>()
}

app.<span class="hljs-title function_">whenReady</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">createWindow</span>()

  app.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'activate'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">BrowserWindow</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getAllWindows</span>().<span class="hljs-property">length</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) <span class="hljs-title function_">createWindow</span>()
  })
})

app.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'window-all-closed'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span>(process.<span class="hljs-property">platform</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'darwin'</span>) app.<span class="hljs-title function_">quit</span>()
})
</code></pre>

<h2 data-id="heading-5">通用布局结构</h2>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/95ae52fea94b4560a4de7db0fdb1f3f5~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=XxQ2PEvxCDFEMd0M8X%2Fit50pYu8%3D" alt="f421c9b8f945563a663c8bc876bb3b7e_1289798-20250928084102365-861716096.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图：内置了4种常用的通用布局模板。也可以自己定制需要的模板。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/6cd20b6371c84d02b1bf930e8c2823e0~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=Xnnbi86KuLckvGTyrQAHTgmU2lE%3D" alt="ac7f37e36c4a7d36e67f2c83fd5a35a4_1289798-20250928084157925-768517553.png" loading="lazy"></p>

<p><strong>经典布局模板</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">&lt;script setup&gt;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Toolbar</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/layouts/components/Toolbar.vue'</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Tabview</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/layouts/components/Tabview.vue'</span>

<h2 data-id="heading-6">vue3+electron自定义无边框窗口导航条</h2>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/8373cc11fcdf4a0489463153b3949130~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=HVmbqVbG1bIoQ1djDueQK3HGKp4%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { winSet } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/windows/actions'</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> authstate = <span class="hljs-title function_">authState</span>()

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> props = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineProps</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>,
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 窗口是否可最小化</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">minimizable</span>: {<span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: [<span class="hljs-title class_">Boolean</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>], <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>},
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 窗口是否可最大化</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">maximizable</span>: {<span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: [<span class="hljs-title class_">Boolean</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>], <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>},
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 窗口是否可关闭</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">closable</span>: {<span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: [<span class="hljs-title class_">Boolean</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>], <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>},
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 层级</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">zIndex</span>: {<span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: [<span class="hljs-title class_">Number</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>], <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2024</span>},
  })

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> hasMaximized = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始监听窗口是否最大化</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">electron</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">invoke</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'win-isMaximized'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">res</span> =&gt;</span> {
    hasMaximized.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = res
  })

  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">electron</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'win-maximized'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e, data</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    hasMaximized.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = data
  })

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 最小化</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleWinMin</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// winSet('minimize', window.config.id)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">electron</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">invoke</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'win-min'</span>)
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 最大化/还原</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleWinToggle</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// winSet('max2min', window.config.id)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">electron</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">invoke</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'win-toggle'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">res</span> =&gt;</span> {

    })
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 关闭</span>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">config</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isMajor</span>) {

        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'warning'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">icon</span>: <span class="hljs-title function_">markRaw</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">QuestionFilled</span>),
        <span class="hljs-attr">confirmButtonText</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'退出应用'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">cancelButtonText</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'最小化到托盘'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">customStyle</span>: {<span class="hljs-string">'borderRadius'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'8px'</span>},
        <span class="hljs-attr">roundButton</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">distinguishCancelAndClose</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
      }).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {

        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span>(action === <span class="hljs-string">'cancel'</span>) {
          <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
            <span class="hljs-title function_">winSet</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'hide'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">config</span>.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>)
          }, <span class="hljs-number">250</span>)
        }
      })
    }<span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">winSet</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'close'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">config</span>.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>)
    }
  }
&lt;/script&gt;

<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">template</span>&gt;</span>

<h2 data-id="heading-7">国际化配置</h2>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/322393ccde5f4cc982f75cd8420e4041~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgeGlhb3lhbjIwMTU=:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767148585&amp;x-signature=Igz%2BTLTN6eEKn42NCXKSl5w5Wus%3D" alt="f53f8a63386532af39f60f7a5f2db6b9_1289798-20250928090551822-1074723762.png" loading="lazy"></p>
